title: Serapeum granite boxes found blown apart

tellings.quote: these Chambers are mysterious but what is interesting about them is that many of them were found blown up like exploded like a lot of energy had surged through and blown them up

plain: Many of the huge granite boxes in the Serapeum, a set of underground chambers at Saqqara in Egypt, were found blown apart, as if 'a lot of energy had surged through and blown them up'. A researcher named Matt LaCroix tells Michels this without naming a source. If true, it would point to some powerful force at work there in the distant past.
